name: solicitation_eval
description: SAM.gov solicitation pursue/no-bid pipeline. Inputs: solicitation text/URL. Outputs: recommendation + rationale.

subtasks.description: Extract the following from the solicitation text and return ONLY a raw JSON object — no markdown fences, no prose preamble, no trailing commentary. The response must start with `{` and end with `}`. Required keys (all 6, all non-null): title (string), naics (string), set_aside (string; use 'unspecified' if not stated), deadline (string; ISO date or as written), pop (string; period of performance), scope (string; one-sentence scope summary). If a field is genuinely not stated in the text, use the string 'unspecified' rather than null or empty. Example valid output: {"title":"Base Telephone Parts","naics":"334290","set_aside":"Total Small Business","deadline":"2026-04-22","pop":"one-time delivery","scope":"USMC base telephone system parts one-time buy"}

gate.description: valid JSON with 6 non-null keys: title, naics, set_aside, deadline, pop, scope

subtasks.description: Using the extracted facts, score the operator's fit and return ONLY a raw JSON object — no markdown fences, no prose preamble, no trailing commentary. The response must start with `{` and end with `}`. Required keys (both, non-null): score (integer 1-10) and rationale (string, one paragraph). Score on a 1-10 scale considering: NAICS alignment vs. the operator's primary NAICS codes and approved adjacent lanes (read from ~/.cerebro/profile.yaml), set-aside preference vs. the operator's designation, size relative to operator capacity, and scope-to-capability match. Example valid output: {"score":7,"rationale":"NAICS outside the operator's three primary codes but adjacent to an approved lane. Set-aside TBD but likely favorable to the operator's designation. Size fits operator capacity. Main risk: tight response window given current pipeline state."}

gate.description: valid JSON with 2 non-null keys: score (integer 1-10), rationale (string)

subtasks.description: Summarize what we can infer about incumbents or likely competitors. If none can be inferred from the available text, explicitly state 'no competitive signal in provided text'.

Based on the fit score, competitive read, and facts, recommend one of: PURSUE, NO-BID, NEED-MORE-INFO. Include a confidence level (1-5) and exactly 3 numbered reasons. No hedging — state the recommendation clearly.
